options.fields:
id = id
title = title
author = author.name
first_tag = tags[0]
price = price.amount
published = published

options.rules:
source = "example"
key = format("{source}:{id}")
title = trim(title)
kind = regex(title, "^(\\w+)")
kind = lower(kind)
published_at = datetime(published, "rfc1123")
collected_at = now()
options.keep:
key
source
id
title
kind
author
first_tag
price
published_at
collected_at
